chunks: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the recurring verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is often interpreted as addressing the two primary realms of creation—Jinn and Humans—highlighting the universal scope of divine grace. The rhetorical repetition emphasizes the inescapable nature of God's favors, serving as a prelude to the detailed enumeration of blessings that follows, thereby urging both groups to recognize their Creator through the evidence of His mercy.
